Now requirement mapping:

req_3a78681dd7f2: Has operated at staff or principal level, setting technical direction across more than one team. Evidence: src_1bbee5699263 shows staff engineer role, but only one team. No evidence of more than one team. So partial_evidence? We have note src_bffc69fed69d says she has been 'operating at staff level' and 'set the direction for the runners'. But not across more than one team. So insufficient evidence. Gap: need evidence of technical direction across >1 team.

req_7600fc34f966: Has written the architecture decision records that other teams build against and represented a platform in an architecture council. Evidence: src_22b8e8455ff1 says contributed runners section to ADRs written by staff engineer, not author. So not written. Also attended council as guest, not represented. So insufficient evidence. Gap: need evidence of writing ADRs and representing.

req_5bcce0eb6846: Reviews designs of major platform changes under documented design review process. Evidence: src_3285cda5cc57 shows reviewed designs as one of two design reviewers under group's design review process. So supported.

req_7f43a00f8ee4: Delivers platform changes with documented rollout and rollback plan. Evidence: src_1bbee5699263 shows delivering runner autoscaling and cache service changes with rollout and rollback plans. So supported.

req_be03e8cd56d5: Documents boundaries of each decision record and each design review. Evidence: src_2486c6d8705c shows wrote design review boundary note and decision record boundary section. So supported.

Now unsupported claims: maybe claim of staff or principal level across more than one team? Not supported. Also claim of writing ADRs? Not supported.

Now produce optimized CV with claims.

EvidenceBoundary: materials establish that candidate worked as Software Engineer III on CI runners team for four years, delivered changes with rollout/rollback, reviewed designs, contributed to ADRs, wrote boundary notes, had prior mobile app experience. They do not establish that candidate operated at staff level across multiple teams, wrote ADRs, or represented platform in council.
